sentences: Number-on-forehead communication gives each player access to all input blocks except the one associated with that player.
The source asks for tight randomized communication bounds for set disjointness in this multiparty model.
Overlapping knowledge makes the problem structurally different from the ordinary two-party split-input version.
Matching bounds would clarify how the number of players affects the cost of detecting a common intersection.
The saved note does not retain the player-count regime, error convention, or target precision, so the full book formulation is needed before proposing an asymptotic expression.
